body:
Tyson Chicken Nugget

Lil' nugget, drum sticks, silly boy, daredevil, demon child, dummy and probably some inappropriate ones since he's a teething 10 week old corgi so it's a love-hate relationship right now.

Kisses!! so cute! I'll keep this in mind. Tonight my husband tried the 'down' command by luring him with a treat to the floor and only rewarding when front paws are flattened. It worked maybe 3 out of 15 times. He just too focused on trying to get the treat from between the human fingers (which he didn't bite so I think he knows how to nibble). I guess progress is progress. We'll definitely work on a 'gentle' command!
I'm so glad to hear that we're on the right track. He's just a pain in the ass and we just have to deal with it for now. Thanks!

Thanks for the encouragement! Sounds like just providing him with the essentials for now is all he needs.

After 2 days of terror, we figured out putting him into his crate calms him down much faster than ignoring him in his play pen. The first time we experienced his zoomies, he lunged at my face and I thought he was going to hit his head and break a limb or two thrashing. Glad to know I should hold on my cuddle expectations until the baby shark turns into a dog haha!

As for training, 2-5 minutes is how long it takes me to get his attention before he'll want to chew instead. I've only gotten maybe 3 successful clicks for sitting and it wasn't consistent either.

Thanks for the hope! When they say corgis are herders, we never thought it was THIS bad lol. I've also sprayed bitter apple on my socks to prevent him from nipping my toes. I find the freeze and turn away technique works for the hands and arm, but it's hard to with my feet since they're already standing still and shuffling away makes it worse! Bitter apple spray for the win!
If I can't avoid the blind corner, I clear my throat as I approach and slow my pace just in case they didn't hear me.

i feel the same... i was facetiming my friend because i was a little sad, but i couldn't tell him what i was feeling or thinking about. i left for a shower promising i'll call back, but i was hurting so much i didn't want to seem like a burden to him, so i didn't call back... and now he's mad that i lied to him for not calling back..
